name: Kuroda Atsushi
source:
Having struggled with depression his whole life, Atsushi is one of the first to light up the mood with his goofy personality to distract himself, and others, from reality. He has a lot of inner demons left completely unchecked, as he was never able to seek prolonged counseling due to family stigma.

Favorite Color: Grey
Blood Type: AB+
